name: Silvio
source:
Silvio is the Vice boss (Vice Capo) of the north werewolf crime organization Oruma Rossa. He used to be [url=/c12330]Romeo[/url]'s close friend and a good rival. After Romeo had ran away from the clan, he hired an assassin ([url=/c12336]Carmelo[/url]) to track him down.
He is the lover of [url=/c12335]Rebecca[/url], who is also a member of Oruma Rossa. Silvio is an impatient person, he enjoys knocking down others more than anything else. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=306925]Getchu[/url].]
